status: implemented (Gate 1 data contract and pipeline, Gate 2 object browser)

entities.source: collection- or archive-level source record (provenance of a specimen)
entities.specimen: one source object: archive item, blackbook page, outline, zine or publication spread
entities.objectObservation: what was directly seen on one specimen (page level)
entities.glyphObservation: one individually identified glyph (A–Z) on one specimen
entities.finding: cross-object interpretation over two or more independent observations

rules: A glyph observation requires a specimen with visualState hi_fi_image_opened_and_inspected or physical_item_inspected, a glyph A–Z, and transcription and legibility confidence of medium or high.
A finding compares at least two observations from at least two different source records.
A finding states evidence basis, confidence and limitation; generatorRelevance validated-capability must name an available bridge capability.
Only published records (editorialState source-checked or later) are exported; every exported observation and finding has German display text (…De).
Display links are page URLs (itemUrl / source url). Image file URLs are rejected; nothing is embedded unless imageRights is cleared and displayMode is embed-permitted.
No ranking, score or style classifier; candidate grammar tags are research notes and never glyph evidence.

pilotGate.note: Until the gate is met, the archive shows the object browser and labels glyph comparison as a research view in progress (spec §7).
